description: This file defines a utility class NameUtil within the com.rusefi.ui.engine package. It provides static constants and methods for mapping internal sensor and engine component names to UI-friendly strings, and maintains a mapping from string identifiers to Sensor objects.

classes.name: NameUtil
classes.description: A utility class for name conversions and mappings related to engine sensors and components.

methods.name: getUiName
methods.description: Converts internal sensor or component names to user-friendly display names.
